name: @sealed-verdict/protocol
description: Sealed Verdict shared verifier as WebAssembly: await init(), then verifyCert(cert) -> { valid, failures }

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path wasm/Cargo.toml && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir wasm/pkg --out-name sealed_verdict_protocol wasm/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/sealed_verdict_protocol_wasm.wasm && rm -f wasm/pkg/.gitignore
